title: India's Trophy Night and Modi's Yoga Push — A Test of Social Embeds
excerpt: Testing react-tweet rendering with verified real tweet URLs
body:
The BCCI's celebration of India's T20 World Cup 2026 victory in Ahmedabad captured the euphoria of a billion fans. Jay Shah handed the trophy to Surya Kumar Yadav as the team basked in the glow of a historic campaign.

The Trophy Moment

The Board of Control for Cricket in India shared the defining image of the tournament on X:

https://x.com/BCCI/status/2030987647607533768

The post racked up over 14,000 likes within hours, with diaspora fans from New York to London flooding the replies.

Modi on Yoga and Wellness

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi continued his push for yoga as a daily practice, sharing a message that resonated across NRI wellness communities:

https://x.com/narendramodi/status/2062361198314861033

For millions of Indians abroad who have embraced yoga studios and meditation retreats, the message reinforced a cultural bridge between homeland and diaspora.

This is a test article for social embed rendering.
author: Diaspora Desk
